audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Poppy on rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 and Skill on row 4, which contradicts the packet levelChart (Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Skill, Poppy, Yasuo, Yasuo), the 50.46% Emerald+ win rate over 755 games, and the page's own whys[] text ('Level 3 reads even', 'Levels 4-5 read even', 'First item is yours', '2+ items stay yours', 'Level 5-6 tips to Poppy').
audit.why: Both layers currently render an answer that its own explanation contradicts. Poppy is a level-1/2 and level-6 champion; Yasuo takes over on crit items.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 3 -> Skill, row 4 -> Poppy, rows 5 and 6 -> Yasuo, proposed as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated in the same atomic group.

audit.why: Spike ladder is sound: Poppy peaks at levels 1-2 (Hammer Shock % damage) and level 6 (Keeper's Verdict, 140s at rank 1); Yasuo spikes at Blade of the Ruined King and again on the second crit item. spikes[] already carries four entries with correct 'when' values.
audit.corrected: Kept the ladder; tightened spikes[0] and spikes[1] text with real cooldowns (W 20/18/16/14/12, R 140/120/100).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability errors. (a) spikes[0].text calls Steadfast Presence 'a passive that grounds you and stops your Sweeping Blade dash mid-air' — Riot's text says Poppy PASSIVELY gains Armor/MR but must ACTIVATE Steadfast Presence to stop dashes. The dash-stop is an active on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown, not an always-on aura. (b) dosFull[1] says 'Wind Wall her Q' — Hammer Shock is a melee hammer swing with a ground zone, not a projectile; Wind Wall does not block it. The projectile in Poppy's kit is her passive Iron Ambassador buckler. (c) Nothing states that Keeper's Verdict is a channel — the kit flags it 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it', so Yasuo's Q2 tornado knockup or Last Breath cancels the whole 140s ultimate.
audit.why: The page tells the user Poppy grounds him permanently, so he never takes the free window that exists on her W cooldown; and it tells him to Wind Wall an ability Wind Wall cannot touch.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence restated as an active with its cooldown; Wind Wall retargeted onto Iron Ambassador's buckler; the Keeper's Verdict channel-cancel stated. Also noted Heroic Charge only stuns into terrain, so open lane turns her E into a plain shove.
sources: enemyKit Poppy P/Q/W/E/R Riot text and flags
ownerKit Yasuo Q knockup / W blocksProjectiles

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns describes Steadfast Presence as 'Grounds you — disables your E dash' with no duration, implying it is permanent.
audit.why: The punishable window is exactly the 20s (rank 1) to 12s (rank 5) her W is down. Without the number the advice is unusable.
audit.corrected: Cooldown line now names the 20s rank-1 window and the 140s Keeper's Verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].t is 'Get E-pinned on a wall' but its .d text is about burning a cooldown for tiny value — the pair does not match.
audit.why: Heroic Charge stuns only if the push ends in terrain; the mistake is fighting with your back to a wall, which the .d never says.
audit.corrected: The .d now states the terrain requirement.

edits.before: Poppy is annoying early: Hammer Shock (Q) does big % trade damage and Steadfast Presence (W) is a passive that grounds you and stops your Sweeping Blade dash mid-air if you dash near her, so reckless E-ins get punished hard. Don't dash onto her while W is up — poke with Q and dodge her Q sweet-spot instead.
edits.after: Poppy is annoying early: Hammer Shock (Q) does big % trade damage and Steadfast Presence (W) is an ACTIVE she has to press — it stops your Sweeping Blade dash, then slows and grounds you. It is 20s at rank 1, so bait the press, then dash in during the gap. Dodge the Q zone's delayed explosion while you wait.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict (R) can cancel your all-in and knock you away or wall-stun you, and combined with her W ground it neuters your mobility — this is a Poppy-favoured window. Bait her R and W, then commit; if she holds ult, respect that your dashes are unreliable near her.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (R) is a 140s channel that hurls you out of the fight — but it is interruptible, so a Q2 tornado or Last Breath landed during the wind-up eats the whole ultimate. Bait Steadfast Presence first, then commit, and fight away from walls so Heroic Charge cannot stun.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Poppy with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats Iron Ambassador's buckler, so she never gets the shield. Hammer Shock is melee and ignores it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Heroic Charge stuns only into terrain — in open lane it's just a shove.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Steadfast Presence: Grounds you — disables your E dash. When it is down — EQ-R her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence is an active, 20s at rank 1: it stops your dash and grounds you. Fight its gap — EQ-R.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Grounds you — disables your E dash. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — the active stops your dash and grounds you, 20s at rank 1. Engage in that gap. - Keeper's Verdict: 140s, and a channel — knock her up mid-cast and it is wasted. - Last Breath: kill windows only.

notes: 1) diff is 'HARD' and diffRating '7.5/10' against a 50.46% Emerald+ win rate over 755 games — this reads as an even lane, not a hard one. I did not propose the change because Poppy's side was already audited and I cannot see what diffRating it settled on; changing only my side would create an inverse mismatch for mirror-fix.js to overwrite. Recommend setting yasuo-vs-poppy diff EVEN / 5.5/10 and poppy-vs-yasuo 4.5/10 together. 2) dosFull[1].t is 'Wind Wall her Q' (15 chars) — it is factually wrong (Hammer Shock is not a projectile; Wind Wall blocks her Iron Ambassador buckler instead) but it is under the applier's 25-character skip, so it needs a manual fix to something like 'Wind Wall her buckler'. Same for focus.text ('Poppy Steadfast Presence', 24 chars) which is fine as-is. 3) The full layer refers to Poppy as 'his'/'he' in tradeGood, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.feeding and report[12].t. Left alone this pass to keep the edit set focused on mechanics. 4) packet.suspectNames flagged 'Bait Keeper's Verdict' and 'Hammer Shock's' — both are correct Riot names, false positives.
